WITH processing_by_zone AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.zoneref,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_diff
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat
),
all_groups_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_avg_remaingb
  FROM processing_by_zone
)
SELECT 
  pbz.zoneref,
  pbz.insurstat,
  pbz.avg_remaingb,
  pbz.avg_cpu_gpu_diff,
  pbz.avg_remaingb / agm.mean_avg_remaingb AS ratio
FROM processing_by_zone pbz
CROSS JOIN all_groups_mean agm
WHERE agm.mean_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
